svg.title: FORJA — Personal gym training PWA
svg.desc: Local-first training app: plans come from a deterministic, fully tested rule engine built on evidence-backed training principles — no AI decides your plan. Works offline and keeps health data on the device. Architecture: INTERFACE React 19 UI (Tailwind · shadcn/ui, Motion · i18n) → ENGINE Rule engine (pure TypeScript, deterministic · tested) → LOCAL DATA IndexedDB (Dexie · Zustand, Zod schemas); optional modules: Supabase sync (EU · RLS · no health data), 3D anatomy (three.js · React Three Fiber), AI glossary (WebLLM · Gemini optional). KEY SYSTEMS: Full offline PWA (Workbox), installable from the browser; Interactive 3D anatomy model, loaded on demand; Passwordless optional cloud sync between devices; CI/CD to Cloudflare Pages with GitHub Actions. DESIGN PRINCIPLES: 0 AI-decided plans, 100% works offline, TS strict mode, EU cloud region. Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, Three.js, Dexie, Supabase, Vitest, PWA. Live at forja-13u.pages.dev.
